title: The triple bond goes all the way
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: With excess hydrogen and palladium, both π bonds of ethyne are reduced. The two carbons retain their connection and form the saturated alkane ethane.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethyne under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethyne is treated with excess H₂ and Pd/C. Which major organic product forms after workup? With excess hydrogen and palladium, both π bonds of ethyne are reduced. The two carbons retain their connection and form the saturated alkane ethane.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
